title: A mix of Dark Souls, Minecraft, Fallout, and Rogue... I love permadeath
author: solace1234
selftext:
(Just some random clips from a game i started around October 1st)

I really love the dungeon dwelling in minecraft so i decided to make a whole game based on that part. Ended up introducing a character sheet with a perk system, tons of different tools/weapons with unique uses, and now I'm working on lore and world progression. You used to go downstairs to the next level, but now you climb a rope to go up to the next level. Exploration became a lot more interesting from that decision.   
  
I've made the game very punishing to players who don't prepare or stay acutely aware.

made with vite, html, javascript

all visual assets drawn by code

(audio was broken so i replaced it)

You play as a reanimated skeleton corpse who claws their way through a dungeon to the surface world. You get one chance to uncover the truth about who you were in your past life.   
  
Loving the progress I've made with this game so far. You can kick things around, use a spell that summons a raccoon to steal items for you, talk to a robot computer monitor, dual-wield crossbows, befriend wolves or gnomes, throw arrows like darts, get set on fire by centipedes, hypnotize draugrs, consume random unidentified pills and potions, teleport... and more!   
  
**NEW MINECRAFT SEQUEL coming to PS6 and XBOX 720 in 2010**

comments.author: Lambisexual
comments.body: Did you use a skill or a rule/guideline or something for the character models? Considering they were made purely in code.

replies.author: solace1234
replies.body: not really, just told the agent to keep things whimsical and "artistically consistent", making sure everything's animated in a frame-by-frame stop-motion style.
